newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Nikko Securities names Asia debt trading chief.
newsitem.headline: Nikko Securities names Asia debt trading chief.

text.p: Nikko Securities Co (Asia) Hong Kong has appointed Calvin Kwan as director of fixed income and head of trading, the company said Monday.
Kwan joins Nikko from BA Asia. He will report to Johnny Chow, managing director for fixed income.
Chow joined the company in January to start up a department for Asian fixed income trading. Previously, he was at Sakura Finance Asia.
The team currently comprises some 20 people involved in sales and credit research, Chow said. The company plans to hire about 10 more staff in coming months, he said.
Nikko Securities Co (Asia) is a unit of Nikko Securities Co Ltd.
